summary: DTS designs and builds auger-based food processing equipment, including blanchers, cookers, coolers, ricers, conveyors, brine graders, washers and bin systems used in potato processing lines. It is based in Beusichem, the Netherlands, and is part of the Sticomax Group, based in Belgium. It reports over 800 blanchers, cookers and coolers installed worldwide.
ownership: Part of the Sticomax Group (Staden, Belgium)
machines: Auger blancher: short-time high-temperature or long-time low-temperature blanching of potatoes
Next-generation screw blancher: blancher with no product guide plate, new bearing method and seals
Auger cooler: counter-flow water cooling for flake, granule and co-product lines
Auger cooker: multi-zone direct steam cooking for flake, granule and co-product lines
Belt cooker / steamer: steam cooking of potato products
Ricer: presses cooked potatoes through a grid into mash at the cooker outfeed
Auger conveyor: horizontal, inclined and vertical conveying of whole and cut potatoes
Brine and clay-bath grader: gravity separation of low-solids potatoes and floating material
Washing auger: removes soil or skin residues from potatoes before or after peeling
Bin system: underwater first-in-first-out buffering of whole potatoes with even outfeed
markets: India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh through MTS Foods
Eastern Europe through Thermal Process Systems BVBA
Ontario, Manitoba, Saskatchewan, Quebec and Atlantic Canada through Chisholm Machinery
facts: Operating for more than 30 years, according to its About page
Over 800 blanchers, cookers and coolers installed worldwide, more than 50 in India (July 2026)
Sticomax Group: over 200 employees, around 70 of whom specialise in engineering (February 2025)
Next-generation screw blancher tested for 1.5 years at production sites (November 2024)
MTS Foods appointed commercial partner for India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh (30 July 2026)
limitations: The website gives no founding year, model names or capacities, dimensions or power ratings for any potato machine.
Staff and turnover figures are published only for the Sticomax Group, not for DTS alone.
No potato processing customers or plants are named on the pages read.
